findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: routersua_search_products, routersua_create_cart_link, routersua_get_store_policy · Private data: routersua_get_store_policy · Public sink: routersua_get_store_policy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: routersua_search_products, routersua_create_cart_link, routersua_get_store_policy · Private data: routersua_get_store_policy · Public sink: routersua_get_store_policy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
